WITH case_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.homefirm,
        c.headct,
        date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
        CAST(c.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
        CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent,
        substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        CASE
            WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM main.cases AS c
    JOIN main.case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage AS pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            homefirm,
            date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
            COUNT(*) AS emcv
        FROM main.cases
        GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
    ) AS v
        ON v.homefirm = c.homefirm
       AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        ci.filekey,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ci.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                rs.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM case_inputs AS ci
    LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule AS rs
        ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = ci.visa_class)
       AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = ci.wage_level)
       AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = ci.h1b_dependent)
       AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = ci.soc_major_group)
       AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = ci.worksite_state)
       AND (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = ci.monthly_volume_band)
),
case_load AS (
    SELECT
        ci.homefirm,
        ci.filekey,
        COALESCE(rr.base_hours, 3.50)
            + COALESCE(rr.position_hours, 0.50) * ci.headct AS review_hours
    FROM case_inputs AS ci
    LEFT JOIN ranked_rules AS rr
        ON rr.filekey = ci.filekey
       AND rr.rn = 1
    WHERE ci.start_month = DATE '2023-12-01'
)
SELECT
    homefirm AS employer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(review_hours), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM case_load
```sql
GROUP BY homefirm
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY employer_review_load DESC, employer_name
LIMIT 5;
```

              WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(ws.settle_fee + ws.settle_cover_pct / 100.0 * ws.replcost), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM (
  WITH snap AS (
    SELECT r.snapkey, r.snapts, COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
           m.makertag, m.pnlkind, a.alrtstate, p.warrstate,
           CASE WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
                WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large' END AS cap_band,
           COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (
             PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
           ) AS claim_volume,
           COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
  ),
  tiered AS (
    SELECT snap.*,
           CASE WHEN claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
                WHEN claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
                ELSE 'Bulk' END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT t.snapkey, w.rule_id, w.fixed_fee_usd, w.cover_pct,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY t.snapkey
             ORDER BY (
               CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
             ) DESC, w.rule_id
           ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
      ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
  )
  SELECT t.snapkey, t.snapts, t.maker_group, t.replcost,
         COALESCE(g.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS settle_fee,
         COALESCE(g.cover_pct, 5.00) AS settle_cover_pct
  FROM tiered t
  LEFT JOIN ranked g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey AND g.rn = 1
) ws
WHERE ws.maker_group = 'Canadian Solar'
  AND ws.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND ws.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2019-08-01 00:00:00';

The query applies the highest-specificity matching charge rule for each return, breaking ties by lowest `rule_id`, and uses the standard charge when no rule matches.

```sql
WITH return_facts AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
        substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS return_month,
        r.return_channel,
        c.seg_category AS customer_segment,
        p.itemcategory AS item_category,
        p.unit_value,
        (r.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
        (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS cmrc
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        cr.rule_id,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                  OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM return_facts f
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules cr
      ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = f.customer_segment)
     AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = f.return_channel)
     AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = f.item_category)
     AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = f.primary_reason)
     AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = f.item_condition)
     AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR f.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR f.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
),
chosen_rule AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM matched_rules
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY casenum
        ORDER BY specificity DESC NULLS LAST, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
),
charged_returns AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        CASE WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE flat_charge END
          + (CASE WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.0 ELSE charge_pct END)
            / 100.0 * CAST(unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS rhc
    FROM chosen_rule
    WHERE return_month = '2025-02'
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    ROUND(SUM(rhc), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM charged_returns
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY SUM(rhc) DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
WITH return_base AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        json_extract_string(r.return_details, '$.reasoning.primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
        json_extract_string(qa.assessment_summary, '$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition,
        p.unit_value,
        substring(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS return_month,
        count(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, substring(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS monthly_return_count
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
    JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE substring(r.revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-02'
),
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        (
            (rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (rr.item_category IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + (rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
          + ((rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER)
        ) AS specificity
    FROM return_base b
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_return_count >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_return_count <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY specificity DESC NULLS LAST, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM matching_rules
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    round(
        sum(
            coalesce(flat_charge, 15.00)
            + coalesce(charge_pct, 5.0) / 100.0 * unit_value
        ),
        2
    ) AS total_rhc
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_rhc DESC, customer_id ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

),

```sql
        p.warrstate,

            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'

        END AS cap_band,
```
```sql
        COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group

    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT snap_month, maker_group, COUNT(*) AS volume
    FROM snapshot_base
    GROUP BY snap_month, maker_group
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        sb.*,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN mv.volume BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN mv.volume >= 4 THEN 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshot_base sb
    JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.snap_month = sb.snap_month
     AND mv.maker_group = sb.maker_group
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapkey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
```
